arbitration_clause.plain_explanation: A private arbitrator chosen by the landlord would decide disputes instead of a court.
arbitration_clause.quote: Any dispute arising out of this agreement shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by the Landlord.

key_amounts.label: security deposit
key_amounts.quote: The tenant has paid a security deposit of Rs. 60,000 to the landlord.

key_clauses.quote: The landlord may deduct the cost of painting, not exceeding Rs. 5,000
key_clauses.summary: Painting charges are capped at Rs. 5,000.

summary.plain_summary: Eleven-month rent agreement at Rs. 20,000 per month with a Rs. 60,000 deposit. Painting deductions are capped at Rs. 5,000 and disputes go to an arbitrator chosen by the landlord.
red_flags: The landlord alone appoints the arbitrator.
